adminPage.logoPrompt:
Design a square icon for the guild “{name}” as a 1024×1024 PNG with a transparent background (no background color, checkerboard, watermark, or text).

- Use: the guild avatar in a website sidebar, shown at 32 pixels and also usable as a 16-pixel favicon.
- Style: modern SaaS logo (like Linear or Notion), flat, minimal, solid colors; no gradients, 3D, or realistic textures.
- Theme: build it around one game element, such as a sword, book, wings, or monster, simplified into geometric shapes and solid fills with consistent rounded corners.
- Color: mainly {color}, with at most a little neutral gray, legible on both white and dark gray backgrounds.
- Composition: frameless, placed directly on the transparent background with no plate, outline, or badge; centered at about 80% of the canvas.
adminPage.logoPromptHelp: Paste this into ChatGPT and upload the generated image to Guild Logo above; it is resized automatically. The color follows the site’s current accent color.

termsPage.section3Content: Guild membership is subject to approval by guild administrators. Members must adhere to their guild's rules and codes of conduct. Guma reserves the right to suspend accounts that violate community guidelines.
termsPage.section4Content: In-platform currency is for use within the Guma ecosystem only and has no real-world monetary value unless explicitly stated. All virtual transactions are final. Guma is not responsible for losses resulting from user error during transactions.
termsPage.section5Content: Auction and lottery features are entertainment tools managed by guild administrators. Guma does not guarantee outcomes and is not liable for disputes arising from auction or lottery results. Guild administrators are responsible for fair administration.
termsPage.section6Content: You are solely responsible for content you submit or post on Guma. You agree not to post content that is offensive, harmful, or violates any laws. Guma may remove content and suspend accounts at its discretion.
termsPage.section7Content: Your use of Guma is also governed by our Privacy Policy. We collect and process data as described therein. By using the platform you consent to such collection and processing.
termsPage.section8Content: Guma reserves the right to modify these terms at any time. We will notify users of significant changes via the platform. Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.
termsPage.section9Content: Guma is provided "as is" without warranty of any kind. We are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the platform.
termsPage.section10Content: If you have questions about these terms, please reach out through our Contact Us page or join our Discord community.
